title: Zion Lifts is founded
description: Started in Hyderabad with a small workshop, a handful of engineers and a straightforward purpose: to help people move better, safer and more comfortably.

title: First manufacturing unit
description: Fabrication is brought in-house so car frames, cabins and structural shafts are built to Zion's own tolerances rather than bought in.

title: Commercial and institutional work
description: The range widens beyond homes into offices, hotels and healthcare, which brings group control, stretcher cars and heavier duty cycles with it.

title: 24/7 service desk
description: A dedicated after-sales operation is established, with an out-of-hours line and an entrapment-first response policy.

title: Gearless MRL becomes the standard
description: Machine-room-less gearless traction is adopted as the default across the passenger range, for quieter, more efficient and lower-maintenance installations.

title: Glass and capsule programme
description: Structural glazed shafts and panoramic cars become a distinct line of work as architects start treating the lift as part of the room.

title: 1,750+ installations
description: Zion passes 1,750 installations across residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare and industrial buildings, with a team of 95–100 people.
